steps.title: Prepare primer and probe mix
steps.instruction: Combine the two modified forward primers (degenerate versions targeting the same region as the original single primer), the newly designed reverse primer, and the new FAM‑labelled, degenerate, extended exonuclease (TaqMan) probe that replaces the original VIC‑labelled TaqMan‑MGB probe. Include the in‑vitro‑transcribed synthetic template oligonucleotide controls (primer and probe controls) in separate aliquots for later use.

steps.title: Assemble one‑step qRT‑PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088), set up each reaction according to the kit’s recommended total volume, adding the primer‑probe mix, the appropriate amount of sample RNA or synthetic control template, and nuclease‑free water. Follow the kit’s instructions for the concentrations of each component; no additional reagents are required.

steps.title: Run thermal cycling program
steps.instruction: Place the reaction plate in a real‑time PCR instrument and run the following program: 50 °C for 5 min (reverse transcription), 95 °C for 2 min (initial denaturation), then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec followed by 60 °C for 30 sec.

steps.title: Interpret amplification results
steps.instruction: Examine each amplification curve for a sigmoidal shape (horizontal baseline, exponential rise, plateau). A positive result is defined by a clear fluorescence increase that crosses the predefined threshold (CT) before 40 cycles. A CT value of 40 cycles or greater is considered negative. No‑template controls (NTCs) must not produce a curve.
